description: This Java class 'JsonObjectValueValidator' is a final, immutable validator responsible for parsing and validating CharSequence inputs as JsonObject instances. If validation fails, it throws a specific exception. It follows a singleton pattern and extends an abstract validator class.

classes.name: JsonObjectValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton validator class that checks if a CharSequence can be parsed into a valid JsonObject, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of JsonObjectValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to validate that the CharSequence value can be parsed into a JsonObject.
